北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 -9℃，风力不小，多穿点，注意保暖防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -9℃ with strong winds. Dress warmly and protect yourself from the wind!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 风力 5级体感 1℃，风寒明显，添衣防风别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels like 1℃ with a strong 5-level wind. Mind the wind chill, dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 3℃，湿度较低，多喝水，防干燥别感冒哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai feels like 3℃, low humidity. Stay hydrated, prevent dryness, and avoid colds!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗温暖体感舒适，多喝水保持好心情哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm, feeling pleasant. Stay hydrated and enjoy your day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗温暖体感宜人，防晒补水不能少，保持活力！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and warm, feeling pleasant. Don't forget sunscreen and hydration, stay energetic!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 4℃，早晚凉意浓，出门多加衣，注意保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hanzhou feels like 4℃, chilly mornings and evenings. Add a layer when going out, stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 3℃，风不大但干燥，多喝温水保暖别着凉！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 3℃, light wind but dry. Drink warm water and stay warm to avoid colds!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感 6℃，湿度高，出门带伞，注意防潮哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and feels like 6℃. High humidity, bring an umbrella, and mind the dampness!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 7℃，风力 4级，风大体感凉，添衣防风哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan feels like 7℃ with strong 4-level winds. It's chilly, dress warmly and protect from wind!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴冷体感 1℃，湿度极低，多喝水保湿添衣防寒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cold and overcast, feeling like 1℃, with very low humidity. Hydrate well and dress warmly!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 大雾体感 7℃，能见度低，驾车出行请减速慢行！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and feels like 7℃. Low visibility, drive slowly and safely!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 -24℃，真的超冷！全副武装，防冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -24℃, it's extremely cold! Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 -16℃，寒意十足，多穿点，注意保暖防风！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -16℃, quite chilly. Dress in layers to keep warm and protect from the wind!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 7℃，风力 5级，风寒明显，多添衣防风哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels like 7℃ with strong 5-level winds. Mind the wind chill, dress warmly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 10℃，风力 5级，风大微凉，添衣防风别感冒！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 10℃ with strong 5-level winds. It's cool, dress warmly to avoid colds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 -10℃，风力 5级，注意保暖防风，别被冻着！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -10℃ with strong 5-level winds. Protect yourself from the wind and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 体感 -13℃，风力 4级，寒风凛冽，全副武装保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -13℃ with strong 4-level winds. It's biting cold, bundle up and stay warm!
